stem:
Meera is watching things move on her veranda on a hot afternoon.
She watches the tip of a blade of the ceiling fan and a ball rolling straight across the floor.
Which motion is circular?

options.text: neither the tip of the fan blade nor the rolling ball
the tip of the fan blade only
both the tip of the fan blade and the rolling ball

teacher.key_rationale: Circular motion occurs when an object moves along a circular path. The tip of the ceiling fan blade traces a circle around the central hub, so its motion is circular. The ball rolls in a straight line across the floor, so its motion is not circular. Only the fan blade tip qualifies, giving key B.
